translation_notes:
REJUGÉE le 2026-09-03 après ldpy 0.6.3 (fiche ldpy/027). C'était le cas minimal et pur de la limite : un seul Namespace, assigné à self.basens pour que les autres méthodes du TestCase le lisent après la fin du bloc. 'as BASENS' lie exactement cet objet. Le préfixe est déclaré au niveau module, si bien que les autres méthodes peuvent aussi écrire 'basens:term' — c'est tout l'intérêt de le garder lexical EN PLUS. Casse délibérée vérifiée : FAIL puis OK.

[note antérieure] self.basens = Namespace("http://example.org/base/") is assigned to self and must outlive setUp for other test methods to read it; `@prefix` has no run-time object (INSTRUCTIONS.md #1, #5), so there is nothing to bind on self. Kept as a plain Namespace(...) call, unchanged from original.py -- the minimal, purest instance of this stratum's expected limit (a single namespace_ctor, no other RDF op in the region). driver.py: setUp(self) has no Graph involved, only a Namespace assigned to self.basens, so a plain SimpleNamespace() stand-in with its default __dict__ equality is enough to compare the resulting attribute across the two runs (no isomorphism concern, unlike the sibling TestShaclCreateShaclPropertyName_setUp region).
optimization_notes: Nothing to compress: the region is one comment and one assignment of a Namespace to self.basens. optimized.py is original.py and optimized.ldpy is translated.ldpy, byte for byte (the @prefix ... as BASENS is in the header, the region reads `self.basens = BASENS`).

repair.driver: The stand-in `self` now compares a probe of self.basens that reproduces the uses found in the clone (test_libutils.py): type of the object, str(), item access ns['hasDatatype'] / ns['numericID'] (value and type), ns.term('x'), graph.bind('base', ns) + a triple minted through the namespace and its N-Triples serialisation, plus the set of attributes left on self. Exceptions of a use are part of the probe.
mutants_killed: self.basens = bare str with the same text (survived the old == comparison)
self.basens = URIRef with the same text
repair.remaining: The second triage question (whether the care gain 0.69 comes from the import line of the extracted header) is a judgement about measurement, not handled here.

header_optimization_notes: Python: Graph, URIRef, Literal and BNode go; only Namespace stays.
LD Python: the whole rdflib import line goes, since nothing of it is used; `@prefix basens: ... as BASENS` stays, the region reads BASENS.
